title: Supplementary data and climatic-niche analysis code for the description of Mitracarpus elnatanii (Rubiaceae, Spermacoceae) from the Brazilian restinga
description:
Supplementary data and analysis code underlying the description of Mitracarpus elnatanii (Rubiaceae, Spermacoceae), a new species from the restinga of Setiba, Espírito Santo, Brazil, based on a single 1987 gathering long misidentified as M. lhotzkyanus.

Contents: the compiled occurrence records of the new taxon and four related species (M. eichleri, M. frigidus, M. lhotzkyanus and M. salzmannianus); the outputs of the climatic-niche analyses; and the R script that reproduces them.

Analyses comprise multicollinearity screening by variance inflation factor (vifstep, threshold 80, on Spearman correlations), a PCA of environmental space (PCA-env) calibrated on 10,000 background points, a one-way MANOVA on Pillai's trace, Linear Discriminant Analysis with leave-one-out cross-validation reported as accuracy and Cohen's kappa, pairwise niche overlap measured by Schoener's D with niche equivalency tests and Holm-adjusted P values, and a test of whether the single record of the new species falls within the 95% concentration ellipse of each related species.

The 19 bioclimatic variables and elevation used by the script are not deposited here: they are WorldClim v. 2.1 layers at 30-arc-second resolution (Fick and Hijmans 2017), to be downloaded separately. The README explains how.
